conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces overall risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions, but may offer limited upside.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to address concentration and meet the mandate.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces concentration and leverage while introducing new, high-scoring setups. Expect moderate drawdowns with potential for steady growth.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the mandate and free up capital.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk due to higher leverage and concentration in volatile assets. Be aware of daily decay in leveraged ETFs and strict stop discipline is crucial.
